motivation: Frozen-opportunity model suggests active-only indicators respond to event-volume growth. This direct empirical diagnostic was specified before computing rarefaction outcomes.
data: Canonical domestic OD annual counts in the manuscript 76 countries; canonical worldwide international country OD counts.
procedure: For each country/system, set event count to its minimum annual observed total. Draw that many events without replacement from every annual directed OD count vector, using multivariate hypergeometric sampling.
primary: Country full-period OLS trend signs in Gini and R; observed versus mean rarefied annual series.
sensitivity: Countries whose minimum annual event count is at least 1000.
uncertainty: Country bootstrap for median trends; simulation replicates are not independent countries. Monte Carlo intervals describe resampling, not population sampling uncertainty.
limits: Equal recorded event counts do not correct all publication coverage differences.
City identities and possible location support can still differ across years.
This conditions on the number of observed events rather than treating it as a cause.
